_what: How full a card's bio must be. Measured on the card-green v1 frame's bio slot: 750 x 318 px (of a 969 x 1352 card), Crimson Text Italic at 38 px (min 22), line height round((37 + 14) x 1.1) = 56 px, so 5 lines at full size. Fill is the drawn text block's height over the slot's height: 3 lines 51%, 4 lines 69%, 5 lines 86%. Wrapped prose runs about 52 characters a line at 38 px, so 160 to 210 characters lands on 4 lines (3 only when they are packed). The fifth line and the shrink to 22 px stay in reserve. The card is baked at that size and scaled as a whole, so the fill is the same at every width the page shows it. Checked by scripts/record_demo.py (each bio as it is written; a miss is rewritten) and scripts/make_tape.mjs (the whole fixture).
